اسرندين (form IIIq)
# اِسْرَنْدَيْنَ (israndayna) /is.ran.daj.na/: third-person feminine plural past active of اِسْرَنْدَى (israndā)
# اِسْرَنْدِينَ (israndīna) /is.ran.diː.na/: second-person feminine plural imperative of اِسْرَنْدَى (israndā)
